articles.title: Tigers' McGonigle and Reds' Stewart Win Rookie Awards
articles.summary: Kevin McGonigle and Sal Stewart have been announced as the winners of the 2026 Rookie of the Year awards by the Baseball Writers Association of America.
articles.content: The winners of the 2026 Rookie of the Year awards have been announced by the Baseball Writers Association of America (BBWAA). Kevin McGonigle of the Tigers and Sal Stewart of the Reds took home the honors in their respective leagues. McGonigle earned a landslide victory with 28 out of 30 first-place votes, beating out Parker Messick from the Guardians and Payton Tolle from the Red Sox. Meanwhile, Stewart secured his award by defeating Carson Benge from the Mets and JJ Wetherholt from the Cardinals. The annual BBWAA awards recognize outstanding performance in various categories, including Rookie of the Year, Manager of the Year, Reliever of the Year, Cy Young, and MVP. The voting process involves 30 members of the BBWAA, with two representatives from each MLB city in both leagues. Their votes were submitted before the start of the playoffs, ensuring that only regular-season contributions were considered. Sal Stewart's selection as Rookie of the Year is notable for his impressive stats, despite a relatively modest 2.0 WAR. He achieved an unprecedented feat by hitting 32 home runs and recording 111 RBI in his rookie season, putting him among the elite group of rookies with at least 30 homers and 100 RBI. The Tigers and Reds will each receive a Prospect Promotion Incentive pick in the 2027 MLB Draft due to McGonigle and Stewart's service time. Both players were part of their respective teams' major-league roster for long enough to qualify for this incentive, which recognizes their contributions to their teams' success. Kevin McGonigle's impressive performance has earned him the 2026 MLB Rookie of the Year award from the Baseball Writers' Association of America (BBWAA). The Tigers' standout player hit a remarkable .263/.330/.457 with 25 doubles and 32 home runs in all 162 games. Sal Stewart's impressive stats also caught the attention of voters, as he earned 20 of the 30 available first-place votes. His strong performance was not limited to his hitting, as he demonstrated speed on the basepaths with 15 steals. The Reds' Sal Stewart wasn't the only contender for the award. Carson Benge of the Mets and JJ Wetherholt of the Cardinals also received significant recognition from voters. Benge hit .282/.346/.430 with 20 home runs and 22 steals, while Wetherholt impressed with his defensive skills, earning a 4.5 WAR in 139 games. Stewart's Rookie of the Year honor makes him the latest Reds player to receive this prestigious award. He joins an elite group of players who have won the award representing the team. McGonigle's impressive stats, including a .278 batting average and 7.1 WAR, made him a clear standout in his first season at the major league level. His well-rounded performance, including strong defense and base running, solidified his position as one of the top rookies in the league. Kevin McGonigle's impressive rookie season has earned him the 2026 MLB Rookie of the Year award. He secured the top spot with a landslide victory, receiving an overwhelming 28 out of 30 first-place votes and accumulating a total of 204 points from the Baseball Writers' Association of America (BBWAA). McGonigle's extension deal, agreed upon just weeks after his debut, is a testament to his talent and the team's confidence in him. This prestigious award marks another milestone for McGonigle, joining an elite group of players who have won the honor while playing for the Tigers. His impressive rookie campaign has solidified his position as one of the league's top rookies. CBS Sports : https://www.cbssports.com/mlb/news/2026-mlb-rookie-of-the-year/

articles.title: College Football Playoff Expands to 24 Teams Starting in 2027
articles.summary: The College Football Playoff (CFP) will expand to 24 teams starting in 2027 after a five-year deal was announced between ESPN and the CFP on Monday.
articles.content: The College Football Playoff (CFP) is set for a major overhaul as it expands to 24 teams starting in 2027. This significant change was announced in a five-year deal between ESPN and the CFP on Monday. University of Houston coach Willie Fritz has welcomed this development, stating that it will provide more programs with access to the postseason. He made these comments at his weekly press conference ahead of Friday's game against Colorado. The new format is expected to offer opportunities for teams from smaller conferences. The expanded playoff field will comprise 19 at-large bids, the winners of the Power Four conference championships, and the top-ranked team from the Group of Six. This change will effectively eliminate the need for Power Four conference championship games. In the new system, the Big 12's automatic bid will be awarded to its regular-season champion. The Big 12 has already announced that this year's conference championship game on December 4 in Arlington will be its last. From next year onwards, the winner of the regular season will receive the automatic bid. The University of Houston could benefit from this change as it was ranked No. 17 in the initial CFP rankings and may be in a good position to secure an at-large bid. The expanded playoff field is expected to provide UH with a better chance of receiving an at-large bid and potentially hosting a first-round game on campus. However, the exact implications of this change remain to be seen as the new format will come into effect from 2027 onwards. The University of Houston's chances for this season are still very much alive as they aim to secure one of the 12 spots in the College Football Playoff. To achieve this goal, the Cougars will need to win their final three games and rely on other teams' performances, specifically Texas Tech losing at least once. In a scenario where UH wins all their remaining games, they would likely emerge victorious in tiebreakers involving multiple two-loss teams, giving them an edge in advancing to the Big 12 championship game. This outcome is contingent upon several factors, including the performance of other teams in the conference. The Cougars' current ranking in the College Football Playoff (CFP) stands as the highest in program history, a testament to their hard work and dedication so far this season. Coach Willie Fritz acknowledges the importance of staying relevant but emphasizes that rankings at mid-season are not a guarantee of success. Coach Fritz's comments on the CFP ranking highlight the need for consistency throughout the season. He believes it is essential to maintain high performance levels, not just in terms of ranking but also in actual game results. This approach will enable the team to stay competitive and ultimately achieve their goals. Linebacker Jaden Yates made a notable return to action after missing three games due to injury. His impressive nine tackles on Saturday demonstrated his ability to adapt and perform at a high level despite being out for an extended period. Coach Fritz praised Yates' resilience, noting that he seems to have fully recovered from the injury. The defensive unit has had to adapt to different players handling responsibilities, particularly when it comes to relaying instructions from defensive coordinator Austin Armstrong. With Yates out, Sione Fotu and Carmycah Glass took on some of his duties, ensuring seamless communication among the team members. Coach Fritz is confident that Yates will return stronger than before, having shaken off any rust during his brief absence. This week's game will be a good opportunity for Yates to demonstrate his improved performance. Fotu's responsibilities were also affected by personal matters, as he missed most of practice last week to attend to family obligations. The Cougar faithful have been rallying behind one of their own, Dell. According to head coach Willie Fritz, the team is thrilled for him, and it's clear that his presence has been a boost to morale. Fritz noted that Dell has responded well to adversity, and his dedication to the team is evident in his frequent visits to practice. Additionally, Dell made an appearance at the Cougars' game against Oklahoma State on October 17, where he was even featured on the video board at TDECU Stadium. The upcoming matchup between the Cougars and West Virginia will also be a highly anticipated event, with ESPN and Fox set to announce the kickoff time within a six-day window. articles.title: Global carbon emissions from fossil fuels projected to drop by 0.4% next year
articles.summary: New research by the Global Carbon Project forecasts a modest decline in fossil fuel emissions due to growing use of renewable energy and reduced oil supplies.
articles.content: Global carbon emissions from fossil fuels are expected to drop by a modest 0.4% next year, according to new research by the Global Carbon Project. This forecast comes as clean energy sources such as solar and wind power continue to expand rapidly. The projected decline in fossil fuel emissions is largely attributed to two factors: the growing use of renewable energy and the impact of the ongoing conflict in Iran on global oil supplies. As a result, oil-related emissions are expected to decrease by 1.9% next year. This short-term response to the energy shock triggered by the Iran conflict may offer some temporary relief. Despite increasing global energy demand, clean energy growth is not yet moving quickly enough to bring about a lasting decline in fossil CO₂ emissions. The majority of the rise in energy consumption is being met by expanding renewable power and electric vehicles, but more needs to be done to accelerate this transition. The Global Carbon Budget projects that total CO₂ emissions will reach 43.3 billion metric tons next year, up from 42.8 billion metric tons last year. This increase is largely due to a slight rise in emissions from land-use change, such as deforestation. The carbon budget for limiting warming to 1.5°C above preindustrial levels remains critically low, standing at approximately 150 billion metric tons. This is equivalent to less than four years of emissions at the current rate. Despite this bleak outlook, CO₂ continues to accumulate rapidly in the atmosphere, exacerbating the dangers associated with climate change. The consequences of this ongoing trend are far-reaching and varied. Research has also focused on natural "sinks" that absorb CO₂ from land and ocean. According to findings, the land sink has recovered somewhat after a significant weakening during the 2023-24 El Niño weather pattern. However, the impact of the upcoming 2026 El Niño event is expected to be substantial in the coming year. This extreme climate phenomenon will likely have far-reaching effects on global ecosystems and weather patterns. The study involved an extensive collaboration between researchers from various institutions worldwide, including the University of Exeter and CICERO Center for International Climate Research. The projection suggests that fossil CO2 emissions will decrease in 2026 due to the growing adoption of clean energy technologies. Clean technologies such as solar and wind power are expanding rapidly, particularly in China, where they are leading the charge towards a more sustainable energy mix. This shift is not limited to one region or country, however, as numerous nations around the world are reducing their emissions while simultaneously boosting their economies. While this trend is promising, researchers caution that a single-year drop in emissions does not necessarily constitute a peak unless it is driven by fundamental changes in the way energy is generated and consumed. The accelerated deployment of solar, wind power, batteries, and electric vehicles is indeed driving down emissions in many countries and slowing growth in others. However, experts agree that more needs to be done to address the issue of CO2 removal, particularly as afforestation and reforestation efforts are currently being offset by deforestation-driven emissions. Novel carbon removal methods remain limited, underscoring the need for comprehensive action on all fronts to achieve greenhouse gas neutrality. The 2026 Global Carbon Budget projects a decrease in fossil CO₂ emissions due to growing clean energy production and the conflict in Iran. This trend is attributed to increased investment in renewable energy sources, which have become more cost-competitive with fossil fuels. The budget also highlights the impact of ongoing conflicts on global energy markets, including the Iran nuclear deal's disruptions to oil exports. articles.title: Farmers Market Interactions Can Have Profound Impact on People's Lives
articles.summary: A brief exchange with a stranger, such as a smile and reassuring comment, can have a profound impact on how someone feels about their place in the world.
articles.content: Walking through a bustling farmers market can be overwhelming for anyone, but especially so when accompanied by a fussy toddler. The stress of navigating crowds while trying to soothe a crying child is already taking its toll. Adding to the pressure are worries about not being able to purchase all the produce one had come for. As one mother was leaving the market with her toddler in tow, she steeled herself for potential judgment from passersby. But instead of criticism or disapproval, she received a warm smile and a reassuring comment from an older woman: "You're doing great, Mama." This brief exchange may seem insignificant to some, but it can have a profound impact on how someone feels about their place in the world. Researchers have only recently given a name to these fleeting interactions with strangers - evanescent interactions. According to Joseph Hermanowicz, author of a publication that shed light on this phenomenon, such encounters convey a fundamental message: "You've noticed me. You've confirmed my existence." These brief moments can be incredibly powerful in making someone feel valued and welcome. Evanescent interactions are more than just passing pleasantries; they hold deeper significance for our sense of belonging. As Hermanowicz explained, these exchanges communicate that we have a place in the world, that our presence is acknowledged and appreciated. These brief interactions have a profound impact on people's lives, creating a sense of connection that can be transformative. An evanescent interaction is not just about exchanging pleasantries, but rather it involves meaningful exchanges of mutual understanding and connection. When people engage in deliberate communication with others, they can convey a powerful message: that the other person matters, that they are important, and that together we form a community. This kind of exchange has the potential to be very impactful, especially in today's world where relationships can feel fleeting and superficial. Hermanowicz' earlier research on undergraduate attrition highlighted the significance of evanescent interactions in determining whether students stay or leave university. His findings suggest that a single meaningful encounter with someone who shows genuine interest in their well-being can make all the difference, helping students feel like they belong and are valued members of the community. These brief, positive interactions between strangers have a profound impact on our sense of belonging and connection to others. Evanescent interactions are ordinary yet extraordinary events that often go unnoticed, but their significance cannot be overstated. They can help alleviate feelings of loneliness and isolation by affirming our place in the human community. This is according to Joseph C. Hermanowicz, who has extensively researched this phenomenon. Hermanowicz's work highlights the importance of empathy in these interactions, where two individuals acknowledge each other's value and humanity. These fleeting moments can have a lasting impact on our well-being and sense of connection to others. By recognizing the significance of evanescent interactions, we can better understand the complexities of human relationships. In conclusion, Hermanowicz's findings underscore the transformative power of even the briefest connections with strangers, demonstrating that empathy and kindness can be catalysts for a deeper sense of belonging and community. articles.title: Nvidia's AI-focused business sees significant growth and demand for its chips
articles.summary: The company's founder and CEO Jensen Huang is now one of the world's wealthiest individuals, thanks to Nvidia's success in the AI industry.
articles.content: Nvidia's AI-focused business has experienced significant growth, making its chips a highly sought-after commodity among tech giants and startups alike for training artificial intelligence models. As a result, Nvidia's founder and CEO Jensen Huang has seen his fortunes rise substantially, earning him a spot on Forbes' list of the world's 10 wealthiest people in 2024. Nvidia was founded by Huang, Curtis Priem, and Chris Malachowsky in 1993 at a Denny's restaurant in northern California. The company has since grown into a household name in the AI industry. Huang's career trajectory took an unexpected turn in November 2026 when he faced allegations of having an affair with someone suspected by US officials to be linked to Chinese intelligence. Huang's family moved from Taiwan to the US when he was a teenager, and his uncle had sent him to Oneida Baptist Institute in Kentucky earlier on. However, after his parents settled in Oregon, Huang spent most of his formative years there. Huang excelled academically, graduating from high school at just 16 before pursuing higher education. He went on to earn both a bachelor's and master's degree in electrical engineering, first from Oregon State University and then from Stanford University. Before becoming the driving force behind Nvidia, Huang started working at a young age, taking up his first job when he was just 15 years old. His early work experience included a stint washing dishes and bussing tables at a Denny's restaurant in Portland, as well as a brief period at LSI Logic from 1985 to 1993. Huang's time at semiconductor company AMD preceded his tenure at LSI Logic, where he worked from 1984 to 1985. It was during this period that the seeds of Nvidia were sown, with Huang and his future co-founders conceiving the idea that would eventually lead to the creation of the graphics processing unit giant. Nvidia's rise to becoming one of the world's most valuable companies was a remarkable achievement, especially considering it joined an elite group in 2023 by reaching a trillion-dollar market cap. Huang's personal wealth has also skyrocketed, with his net worth estimated at $155 billion as of November 2026, according to Bloomberg. This staggering figure is a testament to the company's success under his leadership. As CEO, Huang is known for his demanding management style, which includes giving public feedback and sending hundreds of emails daily to his team of around 60 direct reports. Current and former employees have described him as a hands-on boss with high expectations who values accountability. Huang has spoken candidly about his workaholic tendencies, often logging 14-hour days and working on holidays. His dedication is reflected in personal touches, such as the Nvidia logo tattooed on his shoulder, a memento of when the company's stock price hit $100 per share. As Nvidia's stock price soared after its initial public offering in 1999, one of the company's early investors, Priem, made a significant decision regarding his shares. He transferred more than three-quarters of his Nvidia holdings to the Priem Family Foundation by 2006. The remaining shares were subsequently sold off, resulting in an estimated fortune for Priem of around $30 million. This estimate was provided by Forbes in its 2023 assessment. However, this period also saw a controversy that would soon engulf Nvidia's leadership. In November 2026, allegations surfaced that the company's CEO had been involved in an affair with Alice Huang, who was linked to a Singapore-based cloud computing firm. The US government reportedly suspected that Alice Huang was a Chinese intelligence asset, although Beijing denied these claims. Without directly addressing the allegations, Nvidia's CEO acknowledged his personal transgression in a message to employees. He expressed remorse and sought their forgiveness, reiterating his commitment to serving them with integrity. In related developments, President Donald Trump spoke publicly about the matter, stating that Nvidia's CEO was unaware of any espionage-related concerns regarding Alice Huang. The Huang family's connection to Nvidia goes beyond the company's founder and CEO, Jensen Huang. His wife, Alice Huang, has been an integral part of his professional life, with their two children also involved in the business. Madison Huang serves as a director of product and technical marketing at Nvidia, while Spencer Huang is a product line manager. Jensen Huang's family ties extend beyond his immediate household. He is distant cousins with Lisa Su, CEO of AMD, one of Nvidia's main competitors in the chip industry. With Nvidia's headquarters located in Santa Clara, California, it's no surprise that Huang also has a home in Silicon Valley. This close proximity to the company's operations likely provides him with a unique perspective on the business. Huang's leadership and achievements have not gone unnoticed. He was elected to the National Academy of Engineering in 2024 and received the Robert N. Noyce Award, which is the Semiconductor Industry Association's highest honor. His success has also earned him recognition from prominent publications, including The Economist, Fortune, and TIME, which have all praised his business acumen. articles.title: Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang Faces Investigation Over Alleged Relationship with Foreign Intelligence Operative
articles.summary: A US investigation into Nvidia's CEO is looking into whether his personal life was compromised by foreign intelligence efforts.
articles.content: Nvidia's 33-year reign as a leader in the AI industry has been marked by unprecedented success under the guidance of CEO Jensen Huang. As one of the most powerful figures in the tech world, his influence extends far beyond the company's financials, which now stand at an impressive $4.3 trillion. However, Huang's personal life has come under scrutiny following a recent admission that he had been unfaithful to his wife. This revelation has sparked a wider investigation into reports that he was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort, with Nvidia's board announcing its own inquiry into the matter. According to sources, U.S. authorities have concluded that Huang's alleged relationship with a woman was indeed linked to Chinese intelligence operations. While Nvidia's board maintains that national security and company secrets were not compromised, it has chosen to investigate further, gathering "all available information" in the process. The investigation poses significant challenges for investigators, who must navigate the complexities of corporate governance while considering the potential ousting of one of America's most influential AI leaders. Huang's position at Nvidia is unique, with many experts describing him as the company's linchpin. Nvidia's power structure has been designed to favor centralized decision-making, with Huang holding significant sway over key decisions. This setup makes it difficult for investigators to separate individual actions from corporate responsibilities, adding an extra layer of complexity to the inquiry. As the investigation unfolds, experts are warning that Nvidia's reputation and corporate identity may be at stake. The company's influence extends far beyond its financials, with many in the tech industry aspiring to emulate its success and leadership style. Nvidia's leadership structure is centered around its long-time CEO, who has held the position for an impressive 33 years. During this time, he has established a unique system where decision-making authority rests largely in his hands. The company lacks a chief operating officer, and Huang has about 60 direct reports, creating uncertainty about who would take over if he were to step down. As Nvidia's fortunes have soared since the AI boom took off in late 2022, so too has Huang's influence within both the company and the broader industry. He is known for playing a key role in shaping strategic and technical decisions, which has contributed to his growing reputation as a visionary leader. His success has earned him celebrity status in tech circles. Huang's personal style has become an object of fascination among fans and followers, who often emulate his fashion sense by wearing leather jackets. At corporate events, he is frequently mobbed by admirers seeking selfies or autographs. His close relationship with the Trump administration is another aspect of his high profile, as he has served as a trusted advisor on AI issues and even accompanied them on international trips. As one of Nvidia's largest individual shareholders, Huang holds a significant 3.56% stake in the company. However, unlike some other tech industry leaders, such as Mark Zuckerberg at Meta Platforms, he does not have super-voting shares that would grant him greater control over the business. Despite this, his leadership has been instrumental in shaping Nvidia's position as the world's second most valuable company. Nvidia's dominance of the high-powered GPU computer chip market is a testament to Huang's strategic vision and leadership. The company is estimated to control around 90% of this lucrative sector, which is used extensively in AI data centers. Nvidia's corporate structure has been called into question following allegations against its CEO. The company operates without a chief compliance officer, a position that was queried by the Securities and Exchange Commission in September 2022. In response to these concerns, Nvidia pointed out its compliance committee, which includes the chief financial officer, executive vice president of operations, and senior vice president of human resources. This group is responsible for ensuring adherence to company policies. However, some experts have raised doubts about the effectiveness of this setup. The absence of a dedicated chief compliance officer may leave vulnerabilities in Nvidia's governance structure. This issue has sparked debate about the company's leadership dynamics and its ability to manage risk. The situation at Nvidia bears little resemblance to other high-profile corporate scandals involving CEO relationships. In 2019, McDonald's fired Steve Easterbrook after he had an affair with an employee, violating company policy. The fallout from this incident was significant, with the company suing to recover $105 million in exit compensation and equity from Easterbrook. The dominant position of Nvidia's CEO, Jensen Huang, has also raised concerns about the company's resilience in the face of future challenges. According to Jason Schloetzer, an associate professor at Georgetown University who specializes in CEO succession practices, Nvidia's concentration of power makes it vulnerable to potential issues. This vulnerability is particularly noteworthy given Nvidia's significant role in developing U.S. technology. As a leading player in AI data centers, the company has a substantial stake in the industry's future. Any challenges to its leadership or governance structure could have far-reaching implications for the sector as a whole. The sudden departure of Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang has left the tech giant without a clear succession plan in place, according to experts who warn that this lack of preparation could have serious consequences for the company and the industry as a whole. In contrast to many other companies, Nvidia does not seem to have a well-defined plan for leadership transition, which could lead to uncertainty and instability within the organization. This situation is particularly concerning given the critical role that Huang plays in Nvidia's success. Experts point out that corporate risk efforts often focus on leaks from lower-level employees rather than the potential risks posed by high-ranking executives. As a result, companies may not always be prepared for the sudden departure of their leaders. The board of directors has been criticized for not having a clearly outlined succession plan that would have given investors and stakeholders advance notice of any changes. This lack of transparency could lead to market volatility and uncertainty as investors try to assess the implications of Huang's departure. As Nvidia navigates this challenging situation, several potential interim CEOs have emerged as possibilities, including the company's lead independent director Stephen Neal, Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress, or even members of Huang's own family, who are also employed by the company. The investigation into Huang's conduct may lead to his removal as CEO, either at the end of the inquiry or sooner, according to Burke. This outcome is possible if the board decides to take action against him during its probe. Huang has maintained that he does not believe in traditional succession planning, opting instead to pass on his knowledge and experience to colleagues. He has even expressed a desire for the next CEO to be someone already within the company, although Nvidia has yet to publicly identify a suitable candidate. articles.content: James Gunn and Peter Safran are stepping down as co-chief executives of DC Studios after four years at the helm. Their departure comes just a year after the release of "Superman, their first film leading the superhero factory under DC Studios. The move is part of a broader shake-up at Skydance Motion Picture Group, which acquired Warner Bros. Discovery and finalized its merger with Paramount Pictures around the time of Clayface's release. A new era for DC Studios begins as Jeremy Latcham takes over, bringing his experience from Marvel Studios to the role. Latcham was a key executive during Marvel's early years, overseeing films such as Iron Man" and "The Avengers, and also worked with Gunn on the Guardians of the Galaxy franchise. The transition at DC Studios is set to take effect on December 1, but the impact of James Gunn and Peter Safran's tenure will be felt for some time yet due to a robust pipeline of projects already in production. Among these upcoming releases are several high-profile titles, including the Superman" follow-up, "Man of Tomorrow, which is currently in post-production. Additionally, fans can look forward to new series such as The People v. Gorilla Grodd" and "The Batman Part II. Gunn's and Safran's approach to comic book adaptations has been marked by a willingness to experiment with unconventional genres and storytelling styles. This is evident in projects like Clayface, which combines elements of horror and superhero fiction, as well as their recent attempt at reimagining the classic hero Supergirl. However, not all of their efforts have met with commercial success. The latest iteration of Supergirl, released earlier this year, failed to generate significant box office returns, marking a setback for the duo in their second major release under DC Studios. As Latcham takes on his new roles at DC Studios, he will be reporting directly to Dana Goldberg and Josh Greenstein, co-chairs of Skydance Motion Picture Group. According to Goldberg and Greenstein, Latcham brings a deep understanding of the DC brand and its dedicated fanbase, which they see as essential to the studio's continued success. The sudden departure of James Gunn and Peter Safran from their leadership roles at DC Studios has created a power vacuum that Skydance is eager to fill. To take the reins, the studio has appointed Jeremy Latcham, a veteran of Marvel who brings a wealth of experience in developing iconic superhero franchises. Latcham's background in the superhero genre will be crucial as he navigates the complex landscape of DC's beloved characters and storylines. His departure from Marvel in 2017 to establish his own production company, Latcham Pictures, has given him valuable insight into what audiences crave from their cinematic experiences. As the new head of DC Studios, Latcham is expected to draw on his expertise to shape the studio's future projects and expand its reach within the industry. With a track record that includes producing films such as Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves" and "Bad Times at the El Royale," he has demonstrated his ability to balance creative vision with commercial success. Under Latcham's leadership, DC Studios is poised for a new era of growth and innovation, one that promises to captivate fans and critics alike. However, this decline is not reflected in the booming market for boozy perfumes, which are selling in record numbers. The popularity of these fragrances can be attributed to their unique appeal as a long-lasting alternative to traditional drinking experiences. Unlike a cocktail that's consumed and gone, a perfume inspired by a memorable night out can evoke similar feelings and sensations for years to come. Perfume experts like Jorgelina Propato, Head of Evaluation Fine Fragrance North America at Givaudan, believe that successful boozy fragrances must capture the essence of a spirit-filled experience while maintaining balance and contrast. Perfume evaluators play a crucial role in refining fragrances before they hit the market, working closely with clients and perfumers to ensure a product that meets expectations. When it comes to boozy fragrances, finding balance between contrasting elements is key. Perfume experts aim to capture the essence of a spirit-filled experience without compromising on scent quality. Jake Levy, co-owner of Stele in New York, suggests that people want to smell like they're enjoying a night out without the consequences. He attributes this desire to nostalgia for good times and a longing for the excitement of a bar scene. The trend of boozy fragrances has sparked a mixed reaction among perfume enthusiasts. Some people see these scents as a way to indulge in the excitement of drinking without actually having to consume it, while others prefer to avoid them altogether. Perfume managers are noticing this divide, with some customers embracing boozy fragrances as a substitute for their love of drinking. Others, however, shun these scents because they don't want to be reminded of the experience of drinking at all. This ambivalence is reflected in the range of reactions to these perfumes. The allure of certain boozy fragrances lies in their ability to evoke the spirit of indulgence and luxury. For instance, Bonne Chauffe from Frapin perfectly balances cognac and plum notes, while Eau Capitale by Diptyque has a decadent rose chypre that feels like sipping dark wine. The trend of boozy fragrances shows no signs of slowing down, as evidenced by their runaway popularity in sales units. This is perhaps fitting given that Kilian Hennessy, founder of the perfume line, comes from a family with a rich history in cognac production. As heir to the Hennessy empire, Kilian brings his expertise and passion for liquor notes to every new fragrance he launches. Kilian's perfume line has been around since 2007, and its focus on boozy scents has resonated with perfume enthusiasts worldwide. One lesser-known gem that stands out is Peach Tobacco Oud by Maison Saint Charles, a US-based perfumery making waves in the industry. This scent expertly blends brandy peaches, vanilla, orange blossom, and caramel to create a unique and alluring fragrance. Perfumer Charles Bradshaw's work on Peach Tobacco Oud has earned him recognition for his talent in crafting compelling boozy fragrances. As someone who typically approaches gourmand perfumes with skepticism, this scent surprised me with its persuasively sexy appeal, making it a standout in my collection. The allure of gourmand perfumes lies in their ability to evoke a sense of luxury and sophistication without being too overpowering. A good example is a scent that balances darkness with tenderness, creating a complex and intriguing aroma. Peach Tobacco Oud achieves this balance perfectly, its liquor notes adding depth to the sweetness of the fragrance. This subtle blend of flavors creates an atmosphere that's both alluring and seductive, making it a standout in any perfume collection. Ultimately, Peach Tobacco Oud is a testament to the art of perfumery, where darkness can feel delicious and worship-worthy. articles.title: Anthropic Unveils Two New AI Models: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
articles.summary: Anthropic has announced two new AI models, Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, which offer higher performance at a lower cost than their competitors.
articles.content: Anthropic has unveiled two new AI models: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, in a move that pits them directly against OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra. This announcement comes just weeks after GPT-6 Astra was released. The key selling point of these new models is their ability to offer higher performance at a lower cost than their competitors. Professionals who use AI models are increasingly weighing the price-performance ratio when deciding which model to choose, and Anthropic's new offerings aim to win them over with better value for money. Anthropic's latest move is crucial as it tries to kick-start its revenue growth again after a slowdown in the third quarter was revealed in its recent SEC filing. The company needs this momentum to build before its planned IPO. The pricing of Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 reflects their competitive edge, with costs that are 20% lower than those of GPT-6 Astra for standard input and output tasks. For example, ordinary users will pay $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens for Anthropic's models, compared to $10 and $50 respectively for OpenAI's model. Anthropic's pre-release testing of its new models has yielded impressive results, with the company reporting that these models have helped engineers complete complex software migrations, designed working electronic devices from scratch, and even made significant progress in robotics evaluations. The Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 models have reportedly outperformed their competitors on coding evaluation benchmarks, with Anthropic noting that over 90% of its own code is written by AI. This suggests a high level of proficiency in generating human-like text for programming tasks. While OpenAI's Codex has gained ground in recent months due to lower pricing, Anthropic's Claude Code product remains a top choice among programmers. However, the company acknowledges that OpenAI's more affordable model may be attracting some users who prioritize cost over performance. In areas requiring highly ambitious and open-ended technical work, Anthropic recommends using its latest Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 models. These models are designed to tackle complex tasks where human expertise is often necessary, positioning them as competitors to OpenAI's Astra model in the high-end market. To balance performance with cost, Anthropic suggests using its Opus 5.5 model for daily tasks. While more expensive than OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol, this model could still offer better value if it consistently produces high-quality results, leaving users to weigh their options and choose the best fit for their needs. Anthropic's Claude Fable model has demonstrated impressive capabilities in solving complex mathematical problems, including a notable achievement in formalizing a proof within 30 hours using a team of 1,000 agents powered by Fable 5.2. This is significantly faster than the 11 days it took for an unreleased research version of Claude to accomplish the same task, highlighting the efficiency and speed of Anthropic's model. The company is touting this achievement as a key benefit, allowing human mathematicians to focus on exploring novel ideas rather than spending excessive time checking proofs. In addition to its mathematical prowess, Claude Fable has also shown promise in solving theoretical physics problems related to black holes, and identifying potential breakthroughs in gene therapies. These advancements demonstrate the model's versatility and ability to tackle a wide range of complex challenges. Anthropic is also highlighting the results of an unnamed security company that found Claude Mythos 5.2 to be highly effective in identifying vulnerabilities in code, with one in six confirmed bugs being missed by other models tested. This suggests that Anthropic's model could have significant implications for cybersecurity and may offer a valuable tool for companies looking to bolster their defenses against potential threats. Anthropic's latest models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in design and production, generating three functional electronic devices from a single prompt. The devices included circuit boards, 3D-printed enclosures, and software, showcasing the potential for artificial intelligence to drive innovation in hardware and robotics. The company has also emphasized its focus on safety features within these new models. Specifically, they have implemented safeguards against high-risk cyber activities such as penetration testing, exploit generation, and binary-based vulnerability assessment. Additionally, research tasks in biology are largely blocked by the system. Claude Fable 5.2 is now available on major cloud platforms including Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. Meanwhile, access to Mythos 5.2 is restricted to application-only for cybersecurity professionals and life sciences researchers through Anthropic's platform. articles.title: Cities with Best Support for Veterans Revealed
articles.summary: A recent study by WalletHub assessed 19 key factors across the largest 100 U.S. cities to identify areas that excel in supporting veterans.
articles.content: The challenges faced by American veterans are well-documented, yet there exist many resources and benefits available to those who have served the nation. However, not all locations in the United States offer equal access to these opportunities. A recent study has shed light on which cities provide the best support for veterans. Conducted by WalletHub, this extensive analysis assessed 19 key factors across the largest 100 U.S. cities. The aim was to identify areas that excel in offering resources, chances, and healthcare accessibility specifically tailored to veterans' needs. The data collected by WalletHub provides a comprehensive picture of which cities are best equipped to support veterans. This includes examining the availability of jobs aligned with military skills, proximity to VA health facilities, and other relevant factors. The study's findings come at a time when many veterans continue to face significant challenges. According to official statistics, nearly 3.6% of veterans remain unemployed. Furthermore, around 32,000 veterans are homeless, highlighting the pressing need for supportive environments in which they can thrive. The mental health and well-being of veterans also pose significant concerns. The U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs reports that approximately seven out of every 100 veterans experience post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). Despite having a lower unemployment rate than the general population, approximately 32,000 veterans continue to experience homelessness in the United States, highlighting the need for supportive living environments for this demographic. The city of Austin, Texas stands out as a prime location for veterans and their families, boasting an impressive array of colleges that cater specifically to veteran students. Additionally, Austin's economy is thriving, with the seventh-highest job-growth rate in the country and a median annual income that ranks ninth among major metropolitan areas. Austin's appeal extends beyond its economic advantages, offering a vibrant cultural scene that includes numerous restaurants and arts venues offering military discounts. The city also has one of the smallest projected decreases in veteran populations between 2024 and 2053, indicating a strong sense of community and support for those who have served. The presence of these supportive amenities is crucial given the mental and physical health challenges faced by many veterans. According to data from the Wounded Warrior Project, at least three-quarters of post-9/11 veterans are dealing with some form of health complication. Austin's overall ranking as the top city for veterans in the US reflects its unique combination of economic opportunities, educational resources, and community support, a testament to the city's ability to provide a welcoming environment for those who have served their country. Madison, Wisconsin stood out as a top destination for veterans due to its strong economic growth opportunities. The median income of veterans in Madison increases by 8% each year, making it one of the fastest-growing rates in the country. This significant increase in earnings is likely to contribute to the city's overall appeal. In addition to financial stability, Madison also boasts a low rate of homelessness among its veteran population. With only two homeless veterans for every 1,000 residents, the city provides a safe and supportive environment for those who have served. The next top destination was Scottsdale, Arizona, where veterans enjoy a median income of $68,000 annually. This high earning potential makes it one of the top cities in the nation for veterans' financial stability. Scottsdale also excels in other areas, such as providing a comfortable place to retire and raise a family. The city's economic prosperity is not the only factor that sets it apart; Scottsdale also has one of the lowest rates of homelessness among its veteran population. This combination of financial security and community support makes Scottsdale an attractive option for veterans looking to put down roots. Fremont, California stood out as a leader in terms of job opportunities related to military skills. With a high percentage of jobs aligned with veterans' training and experience, Fremont offers a seamless transition into civilian life. Other cities that ranked highly in this category include Madison, Wisconsin; Durham, North Carolina; Boston, Massachusetts; and San Jose, California. Lincoln, Nebraska stands out as a city with an impressively low percentage of unemployed veterans, ranking it among the top cities for those who have served in the military. Following closely behind are Chesapeake, Virginia; St. Petersburg, Florida; Irving, Texas; and Fremont, California. Meanwhile, Miami, Florida takes the top spot when it comes to veterans' income growth, with Garland, Texas and San Bernardino, California also experiencing significant increases in earnings. Gilbert, Arizona rounds out this group of cities, followed closely by Boston, Massachusetts. Gilbert, Arizona is notable for having the lowest percentage of veterans living below the poverty line, a distinction it shares with several other cities including Virginia Beach, Virginia; Chula Vista, California; Fremont, California; and Charlotte, North Carolina. Virginia Beach, Virginia boasts an impressive record when it comes to providing support for its homeless veteran population, with fewer than one in every hundred veterans living on the streets. Other cities that have made notable strides in reducing homelessness among their veteran populations include Raleigh, North Carolina; Colorado Springs, Colorado; Buffalo, New York; and Jacksonville, Florida. A number of cities stand out as having a significant proportion of residents who are veterans, with Virginia Beach, Virginia tied for top honors alongside Chesapeake, Virginia; Colorado Springs, Colorado; Norfolk, Virginia; and Anchorage, Alaska. The rankings reveal that several cities stand out for their high proportion of veteran residents, including Virginia Beach and Chesapeake in Virginia, Colorado Springs in Colorado, and Norfolk in Virginia, all tied for first place. Cities at the other end of the spectrum struggle to provide a supportive environment for veterans, with Detroit, Michigan ranking poorly due to its high unemployment rate and low quality of life scores. Newark, New Jersey ranked second-lowest, followed by Baton Rouge, Louisiana, Memphis, Tennessee, and Toledo, Ohio. articles.title: Miami Dolphins Struggle with Subpar Performance Despite Young Roster
articles.summary: The Miami Dolphins are frustrated with their 1-7 record and are looking for ways to improve their chances of winning.
articles.content: The Miami Dolphins are struggling to find their footing this season, and despite having the youngest roster in the NFL, they're growing tired of using youth as an excuse for their subpar performance. At 1-7, the team is frustrated with their lack of wins, and it's clear that players like rookie receiver Kevin Coleman Jr. are fed up with being labeled as "young guys." Coleman Jr. expressed his disappointment after Sunday's loss to Detroit, stating that they want to win and can't keep making excuses. According to veteran linebacker Jordyn Brooks, the team's inability to close out games is partly due to their inexperience. He believes that the Dolphins failed to maintain their composure after building a lead against New England in Week 8, which ultimately led to their loss. The Dolphins' performance on Sunday was a step in the right direction, as they responded well to being down by three points at halftime against one of the NFL's most talented teams. However, it remains to be seen if this newfound resilience will translate into wins for the team. The Dolphins' inability to close out victories has become a recurring theme this season. Despite their best efforts, they continue to come up short in crucial moments. Miami's defense was impressive against Detroit, holding the top-ranked offense to field goals until the third quarter. However, the team's own mistakes proved costly, with 11 penalties for 87 yards and an inability to capitalize on scoring opportunities in the red zone. The Dolphins' struggles have been particularly evident in their recent one-score matchups, having participated in four consecutive games decided by just a single point or margin of two scores. This trend continued Sunday, as they fell short once again despite playing well. Rookie linebacker Jacob Rodriguez acknowledged the team's resilience, but emphasized that it is not enough to simply play good football, they must also find a way to win. He stressed that their youth cannot be used as an excuse for their struggles. The Dolphins' defense put up a solid performance against the Lions, but ultimately fell short due to their own struggles on offense and special teams. Pass rushers Chop Robinson and Josh Uche led the way for Miami's defense, recording three first-half sacks against Jared Goff. However, the team's inability to hold up on the other side of the ball proved costly. The Dolphins' offensive line struggled to contain edge rusher Aidan Hutchinson and the Lions' front, allowing constant pressure that hindered quarterback Malik Willis' performance. Willis completed just 13 of 25 passes for 128 yards, including an interception, and his nagging groin injury seemed to affect his ability to use his legs. The Dolphins committed five holding penalties on offense, further exacerbating their struggles. On the bright side, rookie receiver Caleb Douglas continued to impress, catching six passes for 70 yards in what has become a notable trend of improvement in his chemistry with Willis over recent games. His highlight-reel grab in the second quarter was particularly noteworthy. Despite this encouraging development, the Dolphins' special teams unit struggled once again, committing several costly mistakes that ultimately proved decisive in the game's outcome. Punter Bradley Pinion had a mixed day, tossing a 46-yard pass to Kaytron Allen on a successful fake punt but also seeing his opening kickoff fall short of the landing zone. The team's woes on special teams have been a recurring theme this season, and it remains to be seen whether they can rectify these issues in time for their next matchup. Quarterback Tua Willis reported some discomfort during the game, citing a slightly tight groin area. Coach Jeff Hafley indicated that he would provide an update on Willis' status by Wednesday. A notable milestone in franchise history has been achieved this season, with three Dolphins rookies recording at least one interception each. Cornerback Chris Johnson secured his first career pick against Goff, while safety Michael Taaffe boasts two interceptions for the season. articles.summary: Donald Trump has sparked confusion with an unexpected announcement that he had offered UFC boss Dana White the role of White House press secretary, but later clarified it was meant as a joke.
articles.content: US President Donald Trump has sparked confusion with an unexpected announcement that he had offered UFC boss Dana White the role of White House press secretary. The unusual proposal was met with skepticism online, with some speculating that Trump may have confused the mixed martial arts executive with another person of the same name, a former Pentagon spokesperson also called Dana White. Trump's announcement came in the form of an AI-generated video featuring White behind the briefing room podium and UFC fighters attacking journalists, which he shared on social media. The bizarre clip was widely shared online but raised more questions than answers about Trump's intentions. In the face of mounting speculation and confusion, Trump has now clarified that his earlier statement was meant as a joke. He made this clear in comments to reporters on Sunday, insisting that he had been only "kidding" when he offered White the high-profile role. As the situation continues to unfold, it remains unclear what sparked Trump's decision to make such an unusual announcement and whether there is any truth behind the speculation about a potential mix-up between Dana Whites. The video, which was shared on Trump's Truth Social platform, depicted Dana White standing behind the White House press briefing podium, surrounded by UFC fighters. The fighters then proceeded to attack journalists attempting to ask questions, in a clear illustration of the president's views on the media. In the animated sequence, one reporter is body-slammed after asking whether Trump poses a threat to democracy. The imagery was not just confined to the video, as Trump's communications director, Steven Cheung, also amplified the announcement by reposting it on X, with a enthusiastic endorsement of White taking on the role of press secretary. The idea of Dana White as press secretary raised eyebrows due to his lack of experience in government or political communications. However, he is known for being a long-time supporter and close personal friend of Trump's. This relationship has likely contributed to White being considered for such a significant position. Trump's decision to announce the nomination on social media sparked speculation about whether there was any truth behind claims that a mix-up had occurred between Dana White and another individual. The president's post on Truth Social did not provide clarity on this matter, leaving many questions unanswered. The situation remains unclear, with no official explanation from Trump or his team about what prompted the unusual announcement. As the news continues to unfold, it is likely that further details will emerge in the coming days. The close relationship between Donald Trump and Dana White has been well-documented over the years. The two have a long history of association, dating back to 2001 when Trump hosted UFC events at his properties. This connection continued even after Trump's election as president, with White attending his political events and publicly endorsing his campaigns. White House celebrations marking the United States' 250th anniversary took an interesting turn when it was announced that a UFC event would be held on the White House lawn. The move was seen as another example of the strong ties between Trump and White, who have been friends for decades. However, despite their close relationship, White has never taken on a government role or served as a political spokesperson. While some people speculated about the potential appointment of Dana W. White to the position of White House press secretary, there is no evidence to suggest that she was ever in consideration. Dana W. White previously worked as the Pentagon's chief spokesperson during Trump's first administration and has also held roles at the Heritage Foundation and Fox News. As speculation surrounding the situation continues, it remains unclear what prompted Trump's initial statement about Dana White being his choice for press secretary. The lack of clarity on this point has led to further confusion online, with some users suggesting that Trump may have confused White with another person sharing a similar name. Dana W. White, a woman who has been at the center of online speculation, took to LinkedIn to clarify her position regarding a potential role as press secretary. She thanked those who had congratulated her, but stated that they had mistaken her for another person with the same name. White also emphasized that she has experience in dealing with journalists, having previously stood behind a podium to answer questions, although she expressed a desire not to engage in physical combat by stepping into a UFC octagon. Her statement aimed to put an end to rumors and speculation surrounding her involvement in the White House communications team. The controversy surrounding Trump's comments on Dana White has also sparked debate about his timing, with some analysts suggesting that it may have been a deliberate attempt to shift attention away from his party's disappointing performance in the midterm elections. articles.title: Miu Miu presents first-ever show at Lapérouse in Paris
articles.summary: Miu Miu marked an important milestone in its history with a runway presentation featuring youthful and eccentric designs, including the debut of the Coffer leather handbag.
articles.content: International fashion brand Miu Miu marked an important milestone in its history when it presented its first-ever show at the iconic 18th-century Left Bank restaurant Lapérouse in Paris on March 4, 2006. The event signaled a significant departure from its sister brand Prada, which was based in Milan. The intimate runway presentation featured a collection of youthful and eccentric designs, including paper-thin knits, ultra-mini dresses, peplum jackets, and chunky platform wedges. At the same time, Miu Miu's designers introduced a more understated element to their show - a leather handbag called the Coffer. This slouchy shoulder tote in chocolate brown featured a twisted handle and a bold metal clasp. The bag was a subtle counterpoint to the vibrant clothes showcased on the runway. The quilting technique used in the Coffer's design has its roots in 18th-century Marseille, where it was traditionally employed in bedding or upholstery. The matelassé technique, first introduced by Miu Miu 20 years ago, has evolved significantly since its inception. The initial collection's success can be attributed to its early adoption by celebrities such as Anne Hathaway, Lindsay Lohan, and Isla Fisher. Today, the handbags are crafted in a variety of colors and styles at Miu Miu's leather goods workshop in Tuscany, known as The Garden Factory. This architecturally acclaimed headquarters was designed by Guido Canali in the mid-1990s and is situated in the Valvigna region near Patrizio Bertelli's hometown. The property's unique design features a one-to-one ratio of building to greenery, blending cool steel with native vines through extensive use of glass windows. This harmonious balance creates a tranquil atmosphere within The Garden Factory. Inside the workshop, rows upon rows of accessories are meticulously stored, comprising 66,000 leather goods and 77,000 pairs of shoes from past collections. These items serve as both a record of Miu Miu's history and a source of inspiration for future designs. In today's digital age, luxury brands are under pressure to showcase their craftsmanship in innovative ways that transcend traditional marketing strategies. To stand out on social media platforms like Instagram, where visuals reign supreme, brands must create hyper-visual signifiers of quality and attention to detail. The tactile experience has become a vital component of brand storytelling, allowing consumers to connect with products on an emotional level even when they're not physically present. For example, the sight of sequins or fluffy feathers can evoke a sense of luxury and exclusivity, while smooth leather textures can convey high-end quality. Miu Miu's signature matelassé handbags are a prime example of this trend. The quilted technique used to create these bags is both intricate and deliberate, resulting in a pillowy, spring-like effect that invites the senses to explore its texture. Crafting a matelassé bag requires precision and patience, particularly for smaller items like card holders where even slight miscalculations can compromise the overall design. To become an expert in crafting Miu Miu bags, artisans undergo rigorous training at the Prada Group's leather goods academy, where they spend six months learning about the brand's luxury standards and practices. The atelier itself is designed with functionality and aesthetics in mind, featuring 45-degree-angled ceilings that allow natural light to flood the space without generating excessive heat. This deliberate design choice creates a perfect environment for artisans to focus on their craft. The result of this combination of training and environment is evident in the exquisite attention to detail and precision that goes into each Miu Miu handbag, from the intricately stitched valleys of a matelassé bag to the seamless fusion of traditional craftsmanship with modern luxury. articles.title: Supreme Court Lifts Injunction on Border Wall Construction in Texas
articles.summary: A federal judge had blocked the construction project due to environmental concerns, but the Supreme Court has now allowed it to proceed.
articles.content: A Supreme Court decision has cleared the way for President Donald Trump's administration to proceed with building a section of its border wall in the Big Bend area of southwest Texas. The construction project had been put on hold by a federal judge in Texas due to concerns raised by environmentalists and local residents about potential damage to the environment and historic sites. However, the Supreme Court has now lifted this injunction, allowing work to resume. In its ruling, the high court stated that the lower-court judge lacked authority to impose the blockage, citing the administration's strong likelihood of prevailing in the case. The government's interest in securing the border is deemed a compelling one by the justices. Only Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson dissented from this decision, which paves the way for construction to begin in an area where 89,000 people have been detained trying to enter the US over recent years. A 341-mile stretch of construction is planned for a section of the US-Mexico border in Texas's Big Bend area, which includes part of the national park. The government has invoked three waivers issued by former Homeland Security Secretaries Kristi Noem and Markwayne Mullin to bypass environmental and conservation laws. These exemptions were granted in February, May, and July this year. The move is aimed at streamlining construction of a border wall. According to Solicitor General D. John Sauer, Congress gave the government broad authority to build border infrastructure without getting entangled in regulatory procedures when it passed legislation in 1996. This assertion has been challenged by environmental groups and local stakeholders who argue that the area's unique ecosystem is at risk. The Big Bend area has reportedly seen some of the lowest migrant apprehension rates along the US-Mexico border, according to government data. Environmentalists and local residents have disputed this claim, pointing out that the region still requires protection from human impact and development. The Supreme Court has cleared the way for the construction of a section of President Trump's border wall in the Big Bend area of Texas, a key component of his immigration policy. The administration had sought to bypass environmental and local regulations by invoking a 1996 law that allows for limited waivers on border construction projects in high-traffic areas. However, District Judge Kathleen Cardone previously invalidated these waivers, citing a lack of authority in the secretary of the Department of Homeland Security. This decision was made despite warnings from officials that leaving parts of the wall unfinished would create vulnerabilities. The Big Bend area is a critical stretch along the US-Mexico border, and completing the wall there will be part of a larger effort to build a 2,000-mile installation featuring steel panels, vehicle barriers, and advanced surveillance technology.
